reading_rule: Main quantity: M0 in-decline share of the above-chance per-minute AUC with its 7-day block-bootstrap 95% interval. The claim that in-progress detection is a substantial part of standard skill is called robust to H if the lower bound is >= 0.25 at every H; otherwise the H at which it fails is reported. Expected mechanical direction: share rises with H.
secondary_reading: At an H where the rule fails, the larger pre-onset share is read as timing information only if M0 within-regime pre-onset AUC at that H lies above its H=240 value with non-overlapping 95% intervals; otherwise it is attributed to the changed event set (shorter falls), not to warning skill. Written before any result on real data.
